rationales.authenticity: Obstetric guidance is accurate for 1820 (waters breaking, regular pains), 'may she have an easy time' is period-appropriate wish, Irish blessing fits naturally.
rationales.character: Midwife confidence and care shine; the shift to 'full attention' shows Brigid's priority and experience.
rationales.craft: Three sentences; each has purpose; the blessing at the end is a strong, period-apt closer.
rationales.language: Idiomatic Irish English; 'Le cúnamh Dé' is natural; clear instructions with warmth.
rationales.responsiveness: Directly answers when to fetch her with specific, actionable signs; anticipates his worry about timing.
